lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag maaroo mahalaa 1 ghar 5 ||
lines.translation: Raag Maaroo, First Mehl, Fifth House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਜਾਗੈ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਸੋਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ahinis jaagai need na sovai ||
lines.translation: Day and night, he remains awake and aware; he never sleeps or dreams.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਵੇਦਨ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: so jaanai jis vedan hovai ||
lines.translation: He alone knows this, who feels the pain of separation from God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕੇ ਕਾਨ ਲਗੇ ਤਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਵੈਦੁ ਕਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਕਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: prem ke kaan lage tan bheetar vaid k jaanai kaaree jeeu ||1||
lines.translation: My body is pierced through with the arrow of love. How can any physician know the cure? ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਿਫਤੀ ਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis no saachaa siphatee laae ||
lines.translation: Rare is that one, who as Gurmukh,

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲੇ ਕਿਸੈ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh virale kisai bujhaae ||
lines.translation: Understands, and whom the True Lord links to His Praise.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਸੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਾ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit kee saar soee jaanai j a(n)mrit kaa vaapaaree jeeu ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: He alone appreciates the value of the Ambsosial Nectar, who deals in this Ambrosia. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਿਰ ਸੇਤੀ ਧਨ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਰਚਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: pir setee dhan prem rachaae ||
lines.translation: The soul-bride is in love with her Husband Lord;

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਤਥਾ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad tathaa chit laae ||
lines.translation: She focuses her consciousness on the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਸੇਤੀ ਧਨ ਖਰੀ ਸੁਹੇਲੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਤਿਖਾ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sahaj setee dhan kharee suhelee trisanaa tikhaa nivaaree jeeu ||2||
lines.translation: The soul-bride is joyously embellished with intuitive ease; her hunger and thirst are taken away. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਸਾ ਤੋੜੇ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: sahasaa toRe bharam chukaae ||
lines.translation: Tear down skepticism and dispel your doubt;

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜੇ ਸਿਫਤੀ ਧਣਖੁ ਚੜਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: sahaje siphatee dhanakh chaRaae ||
lines.translation: with your intuition, draw the bow of the Praise of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਜੋਗਾਧਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad marai man maare su(n)dar jogaadhaaree jeeu ||3||
lines.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, conquer and subdue your mind; take the support of Yoga - Union with the beautiful Lord. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਜਲਿਆ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: haumai jaliaa manahu visaare ||
lines.translation: Burnt by egotism, one forgets the Lord from his mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਵਜਹਿ ਖੜਗ ਕਰਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jam pur vajahi khaRag karaare ||
lines.translation: In the City of Death, he is attacked with massive swords.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਕੈ ਕਹਿਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਮਿਲਈ ਤੂ ਸਹੁ ਜੀਅੜੇ ਭਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: ab kai kahiai naam na milaee too sahu jeeaRe bhaaree jeeu ||4||
lines.translation: Then, even if he asks for it, he will not receive the Lord's Name; O soul, you shall suffer terrible punishment. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਮਤਾ ਪਵਹਿ ਖਿਆਲੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaiaa mamataa pavahi khiaalee ||
lines.translation: You are distracted by thoughts of Maya and worldly attachment.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਫਾਸਹਿਗਾ ਜਮ ਜਾਲੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jam pur phaasahigaa jam jaalee ||
lines.translation: In the City of Death, you will be caught by the noose of the Messenger of Death.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੇਤ ਕੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਤੋੜਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਹਿ ਤਾ ਜਮੁ ਕਰੇ ਖੁਆਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: het ke ba(n)dhan toR na saakahi taa jam kare khuaaree jeeu ||5||
lines.translation: You cannot break free from the bondage of loving attachment, and so the Messenger of Death will torture you. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਹਉ ਕਰਤਾ ਨਾ ਮੈ ਕੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: naa hau karataa naa mai keeaa ||
lines.translation: I have done nothing; I am doing nothing now.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit naam satigur deeaa ||
lines.translation: The True Guru has blessed me with the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਦੇਹਿ ਤਿਸੈ ਕਿਆ ਚਾਰਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥੬॥੧॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: jis too dehi tisai kiaa chaaraa naanak saran tumaaree jeeu ||6||1||12||
lines.translation: What other efforts can anyone make, when You bestow Your blessing? Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary. ||6||1||12||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 3 ghar 1 ||
lines.translation: Maaroo, Third Mehl, First House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਬੈਸਾਲਹਿ ਤਹ ਬੈਸਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਹ ਭੇਜਹਿ ਤਹ ਜਾਵਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jah baisaalahi tah baisaa suaamee jah bhejahi tah jaavaa ||
lines.translation: Wherever You seat me, there I sit, O my Lord and Master; wherever You send me, there I go.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਨਗਰੀ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੋ ਰਾਜਾ ਸਭੇ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਹਹਿ ਥਾਵਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sabh nagaree mahi eko raajaa sabhe pavit hahi thaavaa ||1||
lines.translation: In the entire village, there is only One King; all places are sacred. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਬਾ ਦੇਹਿ ਵਸਾ ਸਚ ਗਾਵਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: baabaa dehi vasaa sach gaavaa ||
lines.translation: O Baba, while I dwell in this body, let me sing Your True Praises,

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤੇ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa te sahaje sahaj samaavaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: that I may intuitively merge with You. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਪਸ ਤੇ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਏਈ ਸਗਲ ਵਿਕਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: buraa bhalaa kichh aapas te jaaniaa eee sagal vikaaraa ||
lines.translation: He thinks that good and bad deeds come from himself; this is the source of all evil.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਫੁਰਮਾਇਆ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਹੋਆ ਵਰਤੈ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: ihu phuramaaiaa khasam kaa hoaa varatai ihu sa(n)saaraa ||2||
lines.translation: Whatever happens in this world is only by the Order of our Lord and Master. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਧਾਤੁ ਸਬਲ ਕਹੀਅਤ ਹੈ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਕਿਸ ਤੇ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: i(n)dree dhaat sabal kaheeat hai i(n)dree kis te hoee ||
lines.translation: Sexual desires are so strong and compelling; where has this sexual desire come from?

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਖੇਲ ਕਰੈ ਸਭਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਐਸਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: aape khel karai sabh karataa aisaa boojhai koee ||3||
lines.translation: The Creator Himself stages all the plays; how rare are those who realize this. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਤਦੇ ਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaadee ek liv laagee dubidhaa tade binaasee ||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, one is lovingly focused on the One Lord, and then, duality is ended.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਸੋ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਕਾਟੀ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: jo tis bhaanaa so sat kar maaniaa kaatee jam kee phaasee ||4||
lines.translation: Whatever is in harmony with His Will, he accepts as True; the noose of Death is loosened from around his neck. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਣਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਲੇਖਾ ਮਾਗੈ ਕਵਨਾ ਜਾ ਚੂਕਾ ਮਨਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhanat naanak lekhaa maagai kavanaa jaa chookaa man abhimaanaa ||
lines.translation: Prays Nanak, who can call him to account, when the egotistical pride of his mind has been silenced?

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾਸੁ ਤਾਸੁ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਜਪਤੁ ਹੈ ਪਏ ਸਚੇ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਾ ॥੫॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: taas taas dharam raai japat hai pae sache kee saranaa ||5||1||
lines.translation: Even the Righteous Judge of Dharma is intimidated and afraid of him; he has entered the Sanctuary of the True Lord. ||5||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰੂ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaroo mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Maaroo, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣਾ ਨਾ ਥੀਐ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aavan jaanaa naa theeai nij ghar vaasaa hoi ||
lines.translation: Coming and going in reincarnation no longer exist, when one dwells in the home of the self within.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਬਖਸਿਆ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sach khajaanaa bakhasiaa aape jaanai soi ||1||
lines.translation: He bestowed the Blessing of His treasure of truth; only He Himself knows. ||1||
